verdict.rationale: The pack does not document any way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows, such as cron-style triggers, recurring payout schedules, or timed automations. The closest item, 'USDC subscriptions with spend permissions', is a recurring-billing building block that does not show the platform scheduling execution. Auto-credit, auto-liquidation and webhooks are event-driven, one-off reactions rather than recurring schedules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
